name: Bedbug Reporting
description:
This dataset contains bedbug infestation filings for New York City buildings, with 5,000 sampled records and 21 columns. Each row represents an annual filing for a building, identified by building_id and registration_id, and includes the address (house number, street name, postcode, borough), geographic coordinates, and administrative boundaries such as community board, city council district, census tract, BIN, BBL, and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). The filing period is captured by start and end dates (mostly November-to-October cycles from 2019 through 2024) along with the filing date.

Infestation details include the number of dwelling units in the building, the number of infested units, the number of eradicated units, and the number of re-infested units. Most records report zero infested units (about 95.5%), so positive cases are relatively rare. Borough is complete for all rows, with Brooklyn accounting for roughly 45% of filings,
